title: Unified AI Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A cross-domain synthetic tabular data generator that trains a unified AI model across templates for employees, customers, products, finance, healthcare and other data types. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata to fit and generate synthetic tables when the optional SDV dependency is available.
evidence: train_model.py:117-120 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=10) or GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata) and calls fit
